english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for throwing something away or getting rid of it.
Use 掉 when throw means discard or get rid of something rather than propel it through the air.

examples.english: We can discard these old newspapers now.
examples.jyutping: ni1 di1 gau6 bou3 zi2 ho2 ji5 deu6 laa3

examples.english: We don’t need these old clothes; throw them away.
examples.traditional: 呢啲舊衫唔要喇，掉咗佢啦。
examples.jyutping: ni1 di1 gau6 saam1 m4 jiu3 laa3 deu6 zo2 keoi5 laa1
